Minification likewise keeps necessary line breaks and passes a JS-engine compile check. Code relying on template strings or regex literals should still be retested in the target environment.

map.手写词法分析：跳过多行与单行注释；识别单引号 / 双引号 / 模板字符串（模板内: Hand-written lexer: skip multi-line and single-line comments; recognize single-quoted / double-quoted / template strings (${} inside templates is skipped with brace pairing), regexes (context decided by whether the previous significant token is an operator or keyword), numbers (including 0x, exponents, and underscores), identifiers, and keywords. Formatting preserves existing line breaks and only reorders indentation and spaces at line starts to avoid changing ASI; minification removes comments and extra spaces, keeps necessary line breaks, and passes a JS-engine compile check; validation also compiles without executing. History timestamps are formatted as zero-padded month-day hour:minute.
